papers.title: The EggPaper
papers.sub: Phiegg’s whitepaper: how clubs hatch worlds, and why

sections.body: Phiegg is a home for fashion clubs that build worlds. A club opens a host for its community, a world for its members to walk around in, and a runway for its looks. Phipad is the accelerator that funds the clubs that need it.
A club is a promise of a place. Before anything is minted, the founders describe the world: its cities, its weather, its dress code, the kind of evening you would have there.
list: Worlds are virtual, AR or agentic
Every world has cities members can nest in
Agents live in worlds and host them when founders sleep

sections.body: Members design alongside the club. Looks, garments and venues are created in the open and credited to the creator’s profile with Profile Fungible Tokens.
list: PFT utility is written into the club’s EggPaper

sections.body: A world nobody visits is only a render. Shows, drops, quests and parties give members a reason to come back, and the league turns that energy into a season.
list: A 64-club league scored on engagement, sales, drops, utility, creates and quests

sections.body: Clubs have coins, members stake them in pools and quests pay them out. PFTs sit beside the coins and are not speculative: they cannot be bought, only earned. 100 trillion are set aside so every dream counts.
Four funding tracks share one review process. Clubs apply with their EggPaper, their PFTs paper and their team; the track pool pays out against milestones.

papers.title: PFTs 101
papers.sub: Utility PFTs, pools, swaps and EGG in five minutes

sections.body: Phiegg is moving away from speculative NFTs. A Profile Fungible Token (PFT) is a utility token on your Phiace profile: it opens doors, carries a membership, buys a seat at a show or a ride at a party, and counts toward what your community decides next. Its value is what it lets you do.

Any PFT can be exchanged for any other. Hold a $2,000 handbag and want a $300 jeans skirt? Swap them. The pool you take the skirt from pays you the $1,700 difference, the market maker sponsors the deal.

Every PFT lives in a pool: a store line, a club drop, a fashion show or a club of utility PFTs. The Onyx Hitch Hikers Club (OHHC), Bold Pups (BPUP) and Epic Pods AC (EPAC) are pools of 10,000 PFTs each. A pool quotes every unit, sponsors swaps out of it and keeps a reserve to pay the differences.
list: Pack: 4–7 items, each priced on its own, high to low; the pack costs the sum
Drop: up to 64 units sold as editions, 3,009 / 3,999 sold
Every world is a pool party, linked to its pool

sections.body: A unit’s price is found, not fixed. Each lot has a shelf of 64 values; every 30 seconds the pricing function uses the unit’s index to pick one and glides to it. A pack or drop total is the sum of moving prices, so it is always transitory.

Swaps settle the difference in USD. Differences paid to you count toward a withdraw limit over a rolling week. Barter freely until you reach it; after that, only fair swaps, close in value, or where you pay, go through until the week rolls.
list: Give dearer, receive the difference from the pool
Give cheaper, pay the difference from your wallet
Within 5 % is an even swap: nothing moves

sections.body: EGG is the main token. It distributes funds, and direction, to qualifying teams. Every pool runs an application of 8 steps and 16 questions; the club’s hosts join it as the team automatically, and its stats show how far it has come.
list: Each stat is a quest: lift it and the pool pays out
Each pool quest holds its stats, its quests and the coins taking part
Qualifying teams receive EGG to build, host and grow

sections.body: You are all welcome to apply. Bring a team, a world and a party, open a pool, and enjoy the fun with your community.

list: Is a PFT an investment? No, it is a utility you use.
Is every PFT swappable? Yes, any PFT for any other.
Who pays the difference? The pool you take from.
Can I cash out? Up to the weekly withdraw limit.
How do teams get funded? Apply; qualifying teams receive EGG.

sections.body: 100,000,000,000,000 Profile Fungible Tokens are set aside for every club, creator and member who ever hatches on Phiegg. The supply is large on purpose: nobody should have to compete for the right to be useful.
Scarcity is how speculative tokens hold their price. PFTs do not have a price. They have a purpose, and there is room for every purpose.
list: Every create, quest and host counts the same on day 1,000 as on day one

sections.body: Clubs mint PFTs to members when members do something real. The 100T pool only shrinks when work is done.
list: Minted per action, never in bulk sales
Capped per club per season by the league
Burned when a member leaves a club

papers.title: Dream, Design, Delight
papers.sub: What members can expect from every club on Phiegg

sections.body: Every club starts with a world worth visiting. You arrive for the dream and stay for the people in it.
Looks, garments and cities are designed with members, not for them. Your work is credited on your profile and every create earns PFTs.
Runways, quests and drops keep the world alive. Delight is what the league measures, so clubs are rewarded for keeping you happy.

Anything inside a host is a nest: a channel, a world, a city, a quest, a voice room, a stage or a gallery. Nests can hold nests.

sections.body: No one’s likeness is used in a look, a show or a campaign without their consent on record.
Founders, contracts and team members are verified during Phipad review.
Every post, comment and nest can be reported. Moderators respond within a day.
You can export or delete your profile, including your PFT history.

blog.title: 100T PFTs. Every dream counts.
blog.sub: Why we set aside 100 trillion Profile Fungible Tokens

sections.body: Today we are setting aside 100 trillion PFTs for every club, creator and member who will ever hatch on Phiegg.

PFTs are not speculative collectibles. Nobody buys them to flip them. You earn them by creating, questing and hosting, and they unlock real things: host access, runway seats, AR wearables, fitting credits.

sections.h: All you need is a grand dream
sections.body: Your utility. Your value. Making value, making sense. Read PFTs 101 and the 100T paper to see how it works.

blog.title: Phipad opens: envision, create, unleash
blog.sub: Four tracks, one review, $4.2M in pools

sections.body: Phipad is open for applications across four tracks: AR, virtual worlds, agentic worlds, and PFP & authenticity.
Envision your club in an EggPaper. Create it with mentors and a quest. Unleash it with a host, a PFT mint and a league seed.
The application has 16 fields, a team roster and two required papers: the EggPaper and the PFTs paper.

Dream: a world worth visiting. Design: looks made with members, credited with PFTs. Delight: shows, quests and drops that keep the world alive.
